meta.name: google-ads-audit
meta.description: Google Ads account audit and business context setup. Run this first — it gathers business information, analyzes account health, and saves context that all other ads skills reuse. Trigger on "audit my ads", "ads audit", "set up my ads", "onboard", "account overview", "how's my account", "ads health check", "what should I fix in my ads", or when the user is new to NotFair and hasn't run an audit before. Also trigger proactively when other ads skills detect that business-context.json is missing.

copy.tagline: 审计谷歌广告账户并设置业务上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你管理谷歌广告账户并需要快速了解账户健康状况。
copy.tagline_en: Audit your Google Ads account and set up business context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and need a quick health overview.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先检查你的 Google Ads 账户健康度，收集业务信息，生成三个核心指标（浪费金额、需求捕获率、每次转化成本），并保存业务背景文件，供其他广告技能复用。
howto.when: 当你提到“审计我的广告”、“广告健康检查”等关键词，或者你刚使用 NotFair 且未运行过审计时触发。其他广告技能发现缺少业务背景文件时也会主动触发。

say.text: 审计我的 Google Ads 账户
say.note: 触发完整审计，生成三个核心指标和详细报告。

say.text: 检查广告账户的健康状况
say.note: 触发健康检查，重点关注浪费和转化问题。

say.text: 帮我设置广告账户的业务背景
say.note: 触发业务信息收集，为后续优化做准备。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits your Google Ads account health, gathers business info, generates three pulse metrics (waste, demand captured, CPA), and saves business context for reuse by other ad skills.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "audit my ads", "ads health check", or similar phrases, or when you're new to NotFair and haven't run an audit. Also triggered proactively when other ad skills detect missing business context.

say_en.note: Triggers full audit with three pulse metrics and detailed report.

say_en.text: Check the health of my ad account
say_en.note: Triggers health check focusing on waste and conversions.

say_en.text: Set up business context for my ads
say_en.note: Triggers business info collection for later optimization.
